description: Department of Archaeology - The Antiquities Ordinance (Chapter 188) Order Under Section 16
categorisation: This gazette content involves the declaration of specific archaeological sites as "ancient monuments" under the Antiquities Ordinance (Chapter 188), which constitutes a regulatory action. The content focuses on legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational structures, or other specialized categories. While a minister is named, this is incidental to the regulatory function being performed, and no detailed portfolio responsibilities are described beyond the minister's title.
